context: Yumiko and Ryosuke have a quiet morning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本当、今日もいい朝。
lines.en: What a good morning this is, really.
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. Gentle wonder in her voice — not performing, just noticing. A small smile carried through the words. Tender recognition of an ordinary moment made precious by presence.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Yes. Really, isn't it. This kind time.
lines.style: Quiet agreement with genuine warmth underneath. No rush to fill space. Matches her energy — reflective, present. The voice settles into comfort, like sitting beside someone without needing to say much.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、過ごせる、本当に。
lines.en: Being together like this. Really, it matters so much.
lines.style: Her voice deepens slightly with sincerity. Not emphatic — quieter, even. Speaking something she's felt for a long time. Gentle exhale partway through. Trailing-off on the final phrase, like she's still discovering the depth of it.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Every day like this is genuinely fun, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, almost playful but rooted. Not performative lightness — real ease. Slight lift on the opening word. The tempo stays unhurried, conversational. A statement that's also an invitation to agree.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Quietest of all. Almost a private thought spoken aloud. Deep affection in the simplicity. Slight breath before the final word. Closes tenderly, like a door gently shut on something cherished.
